description: Builds a complete IVR (phone menu / auto-attendant) script for a business: greeting, numbered options, optional Spanish-language switch, and the operator line. English, Spanish, or bilingual.

greeting.description: Custom opening greeting. Default: 'Thank you for calling {business}.'

industry.description: Pick the closest industry; supplies sensible default menu options.

language.description: Menu language. 'both' adds a press-nine Spanish switch. Default: en.

options.description: Menu options in order (press 1, press 2, …). Defaults to the industry's standard four.

name: write_ivr_menu
title: Write an IVR phone-menu script
